issues.description: The solution defines the subroutine with the label ".set_pixel" while the template (and the problem statement) refer to and call the symbol "set_pixel". This naming difference (leading dot) is likely unintentional and will prevent the call from resolving correctly, causing a linkage/assembly error or an unresolved symbol at runtime and confusing students.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the subroutine name consistent across all artifacts. Rename the label in the solution from ".set_pixel" to "set_pixel" (or change the call sites to match the defined symbol). Ensure the symbol name used in 'call set_pixel' matches the label exactly so the assembler/linker can resolve the call.
